# Verification Anchored Delivery

Treat verification as part of design, not an afterthought.

## Define success early

Extract pass/fail signals from the instruction: commands to run, files that must exist, properties outputs must satisfy.

## Intermediate proofs

When mistakes cascade, prove smaller units before assembling the full pipeline.

## Output inspection

Read actual generated bytes when format matters; serialization and encoding surprises hide in “looks correct” code.
